combo_label: At the Seaside × Board Game Night × Pirates & the High Seas

entries.clue: Diamond of fabric on a long string, flown where the breeze never drops
Striped canvas seat that folds flat, and nips your fingers if you rush it
Card pile that may fine you for speeding or march you back three spaces
Short curved sword, the boarding party's sidearm of choice
Lay letter tiles for a triple-word score, then dare anyone to challenge it
Scorecard game where five matching faces earn a fifty-point shout
One-sided fashion statement that halves the wearer's depth perception
Caribbean sea raider Tampa Bay named its NFL team after
Squawking white bird that will happily mug you for your lunch
Nautical hello bellowed across the water
